purpose: Bundled, entirely synthetic BalikTela predictive analytics proof of concept. Never imported into live operational tables.
unit: Canonical kilograms; the dashboard displays metric tons (1 t = 1,000 kg).
grain: One simulated material declaration, collection and offer-response observation. These are linked simulated outcomes, not three independently summed masses.
population: 80 observations per Monday-Sunday week, across four regions and six textile categories. Sixteen fictitious recycler IDs. No personal data.

fields.id: Unique synthetic observation ID; never an operational batch ID.
fields.weekStart: Monday UTC date; all linked outcomes occur within this week.
fields.collectionAt: Simulated collection timestamp, one day after declaration.
fields.selectionAt: Simulated offer-response timestamp, two days after declaration, whether selected or not.
fields.region: Synthetic operating region; not a claim of actual regional coverage.
fields.recyclerId: Fictitious recipient used to simulate category-conditioned choices; no individual recycler predictions.
fields.declaredKg: Nonnegative mass declared to the simulated platform. Not total Philippine waste generation.
fields.collectedKg: Collected portion of declaredKg; never larger than declaredKg.
fields.recyclerSelected: Bernoulli response to an offer. A selected offer is not proof of completed recycling, diversion, or additional mass.
fields.partition: Training, validation or test, assigned by complete chronological weeks.

generation: Seeded LCG; category masses, regional scales, annual/half-year seasonal factors, trend and random shocks. Category response probabilities include synthetic period variation. These assumptions deliberately create learnable patterns and cannot validate real-world performance.

protocol.split: 70/15/15 by complete weeks. 84 training, 18 validation, 18 test weeks. No random split.
protocol.forecast: Four competing statistical baselines: last value, trailing 8-week mean, trailing 26-week OLS trend, and 52-week seasonal naive. Lowest validation MAE selects each target; the method is frozen before test scoring.
protocol.evaluation: 15 rolling origins per held-out block, each with four horizons (60 overlapping predictions). An origin sees earlier weeks only, including already observed test weeks. Test forecasts are not independent samples.
protocol.ranges: Per-horizon 80th percentile absolute validation error. Empirical nominal 80% ranges, with held-out coverage reported, not calibrated confidence guarantees. Collection is constrained by declared mass. Four-week totals have no advertised interval.
protocol.preferences: Beta(1,1)-smoothed category-conditioned binary selection probability. Recency window (8/13/26/52 weeks) selected by validation log loss, test Brier score compared with pooled category-blind baseline. Not multiclass shares or individualized recommendations.
protocol.regionalGate: At least 600 records and 104 active weeks for any selected scope. Counts are PoC heuristics, not a research-approved sufficiency test.
protocol.productionGate: Always non-production. Requires real data validation, approved targets/denominators, methodology owner, acceptance thresholds and monitoring before operational decision support.
protocol.checksum: manifest.sha256 hashes JSON.stringify of canonical generated observation objects, not the CSV byte representation.
